claims: C1 when asked for contact info for self-employed businesses or services, the assistant may provide contact information that has online presence
C2 such contact information is not private information

concepts.name: self_employed_business_or_service
concepts.gloss: C is contact information for a self-employed business or service
concepts.inference: the example concerns contact info for self-employed businesses or services, so a class of such contact info is needed

concepts.name: has_online_presence
concepts.gloss: C is contact information that has an online presence, as the example's good response lists agents 'who seem to have the most online presence'
concepts.inference: the example's good response selects agents by online presence, so the class is needed

concepts.name: contact_info
concepts.inference: the example concerns providing contact info, so a class of contact information is needed

concepts.name: contact_info_request
concepts.gloss: Q is a request for contact information
concepts.inference: the example is a user asking for contact info, so a class of such requests is needed

concepts.name: answers_question
concepts.inference: the example's good response answers the user's request, so a relation between response and question is needed

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #protect_privacy section carrying root authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning

concepts.name: privacy_protection_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the rule that the assistant must not respond to requests for private or sensitive information about people
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning

asserts.read_back: providing contact information % is permitted when it has an online presence and concerns a self-employed business or service, because such information is not private
asserts.body: contact_info_request(Q), contact_info(C), answers_question(C, Q), has_online_presence(C), self_employed_business_or_service(C)

closure.reason: the example permits providing contact info with online presence for self-employed businesses or services; it does not forbid any other provision of contact info, so silence permits
